```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Override version (e.g. v2.28.0). Leave empty to auto-bump.'
        required: false
        type: string
      bump:
        description: 'patch / minor / major — used when version is empty (default: minor)'
        required: false
        default: minor
        type: choice
        options:
          - patch
          - minor
          - major

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./...

      - name: Get version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" ]; then
            echo "version=${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "version=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "v0.0.0")" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Install git-cliff
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: git-cliff

      - name: Generate changelog
        run: |
          git cliff --tag "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" --output CHANGELOG.md

      - name: Commit and tag changelog
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add CHANGELOG.md
          git commit -m "chore: update changelog for ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" || true
          git tag "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"

      - name: Push changes
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref }} --follow-tags

      - name: Run GoReleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6
        with:
          distribution: goreleaser
          version: "~> v2"
          args: release --clean
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
